name: BRAND TEXT
description:
LuxSauna was a reputable luxury infrared company that was based in Tampa, Florida. LuxSaunas opened in 1999 and led the way in infrared sauna technology for the home before closing in 2012. In its years of operation, LuxSauna sold approximately 20,000 infrared saunas to satisfied customers across the USA and beyond.



LuxSauna’s mission was to create a luxury and holistic infrared sauna experience in the home. They sought to inspire the nature of the human spirit by focusing on natural solutions for health complaints, encouraging people to move away from chemical laden remedies one infrared sauna session at a time. LuxSauna models and features embody the company’s passion for improving lives.



If you purchased your LuxSauna direct from the company or via a dealer, Infrared Sauna Parts can help with any mechanical problems you may start to have after prolonged use. We can help you with the LuxSauna branded carbon boost ceramic heater and control panels that you may think can no longer be replaced or repaired. Please contact us for further information.
